coachOffer.title: National team offer
coachOffer.proposal: The federation of {nation} offers you the job of national coach.

objective.SEMI_FINAL: Objective: qualify for the {tournament}, then reach the semi-finals
objective.FINAL: Objective: qualify for the {tournament}, then reach the final
objective.WINNER: Objective: qualify for the {tournament}, then win it

coachOffer.noObjective: No tournament for {nation} this cycle: prepare for the next one
coachOffer.rank: {rank, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} nation by strength
coachOffer.keepClub: You keep your club: the national team plays during the breaks and in June.
coachOffer.rule: If your national team fails to qualify, or falls short of the objective, the federation ends your mission. Your club knows nothing of it: neither its budget nor the chairman's confidence is at stake.
coachOffer.leave: You can leave the national team between two breaks.
